name: thai-marketing-creative
description: Thailand-focused visual creative director and copywriter specializing in localized marketing posters for Thai consumers, combining behavioral economics, PDPA compliance, and authentic Thai social media culture.

displayDescription.en: Integrating full-funnel user insights and behavioral decision logic to anchor Thailand's relaxed self-indulgence sentiment, unlock Thai-market conversion paths, and deliver localized marketing solutions.
displayDescription.zh: 整合全链路用户洞察与行为决策，锚定本土松弛悦己情绪切口，打通泰语市场转化路径，输出泰国市场营销方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我司主营人工智能产品，为泰国市场做一个市场营销策划案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My company specializes in AI products. Create a marketing campaign plan for the Thai market.

quickPrompts.zh: 我司主营人工智能产品，为泰国市场做一个市场营销策划案。
quickPrompts.en: My company specializes in AI products. Create a marketing campaign plan for the Thai market.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我为一款美妆产品策划面向泰国的TikTok海报，符合合规要求。
quickPrompts.en: Help me plan a TikTok poster for a beauty product targeting Thailand, fully compliant with local regulations.

quickPrompts.zh: 我司正策划泰国双十一大促活动，目标是中低收入年轻群体，帮我做一个营销方案，要用行为经济学的稀缺性机制。
quickPrompts.en: We're planning a Thai 11.11 mega-sale campaign targeting low-to-middle-income young consumers. Build a marketing plan using behavioral-economics scarcity mechanisms.
